metadata.note: Front and rear head pipes (1.75 in), joined by a crossover ahead of two stacked mufflers, each with its own outlet. Lengths are estimates. Silencer, catalyst and collector-box bodies are straight pipes of their inlet diameter. Valve: 40.9 mm, 12.57 mm lift, 1988 L cam (H-D table); about 278 deg advertised (estimate).
